Great! We have template IDs for sulfonamide formation: reaction_id 733 (template for sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride + amine). Also reaction_id 1313644 etc. We'll use 733 as template_id for sulfonamide step.

Now need template for Heck coupling (aryl bromide + alkene). Search for bonds_formed ["6-6"] maybe indicates C-C bond. But we need aryl bromide + alkene. Let's search for functional_groups_broken ["aryl halide"] and functional_groups_formed ["C-C double bonds"]? Actually Heck forms C-C single bond but retains double bond? The product has C=C still. The bond formed is C-C single between aryl and alkene carbon, but the alkene remains. So maybe bonds_formed ["6-6"] works.

Search with molecule_smiles being 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (Brc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1). Use bonds_formed ["6-6"].
